purpose: Define source-bound atom types for future extraction without admitting live atoms.

evidence_atom_types.label: Source carrier observation
evidence_atom_types.definition: A bounded observation that a carrier family or carrier page exists or is named.
evidence_atom_types.notes: Atom types define future extraction shapes only; rev0018 creates no live evidence atoms.

evidence_atom_types.label: Source-page row observation
